contract: A23-75 (user 2026-10-08): Config.GamePasses XP2 (2x XP, 199) / Gold2 (2x Gold, 149) / VIP (249), Attr PassXP2 / PassGold2 / PassVIP, Id 0 = not sold (never asked, 'Coming soon'). At join the server asks Roblox (UserOwnsGamePassAsync, 3 tries, waits 1 s then 2 s; every try failing = the last saved answer, data.PassSeen) and PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished (purchased) turns a pass on at once (a late 'no' never takes it back that session). Review 2026-10-08: the saved answer of a sold pass counts from PlayerReady until Roblox answers (grants paid while joining see it). x2 applies once per grant in ProgressionService: every XP grant, and gold from the earned sources (Monster, Quest, Event, Bounty, War, Loot, Kaiju minted hunt part, SignOn, Attendance) - never Sale / Refund / Plunder / KaijuBank / KaijuTransfer / KaijuBonus (the survive bonus, half a pouch that already holds the pass; only its cap doubles) / Penalty / Other; GetXPMult / GetGoldMult leave it out; the A23-27 one-level cap holds after it; each grant returns what was added and every line shown uses it. Looks: 4 sold (99) + 6 attendance-only (14 / 50 / 100 days, GrantLook), LooksOwned in shop order, LookOn = an owned look of the player's faction (SetLook, 0.5 s; a faction switch hides it). VIP owners go on the supporter board (GameState SupporterNames, newest first, 30, a shared DataStore list read every 5 min; a hidden name never: hiding later, rejoining hidden or a refund takes it off here at once and off the shared list, one shared write per player per 10 s with the latest choice). Studio DebugCommand Pass / LookGrant are session-only test aids.
limitations: MarketplaceService, DataStores, Players and the PlayerService are doubles; real Roblox answer times, purchase prompts, game pass ids and the shared list across real servers are only checkable after the user creates the passes (Studio / a published test). The grant sites outside ProgressionService are checked as source text (their source and that their line uses the returned amount), not run, except KaijuService's survive() reward (extracted and run on the real ProgressionService; the kaiju event around it is a stand-in).
